job.Job Title: Full Stack Development - Internship (WFH & Part Time)
job.Job Description:
Intern's Day-to-Day Responsibilities - Full Stack Development
Assist in developing and maintaining web applications from frontend to backend.
Build responsive and user-friendly interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frontend frameworks.
Develop and maintain backend applications, APIs, and server-side functionality.
Work with databases to store, retrieve, and manage application data.
Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and third-party services.
Write clean, reusable, and well-structured code following development best practices.
Assist in identifying, debugging, and resolving software bugs and technical issues.
Perform testing to ensure applications are functional, responsive, and reliable.
Use Git/GitHub for version control and collaborate with the development team.
Assist with deploying and maintaining applications in development or cloud environments.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving application performance.
Understand project requirements and convert them into technical solutions.
Maintain technical documentation for applications, APIs, and development processes.
Stay updated with current web development technologies, frameworks, and industry practices.
Contribute to real-world full-stack projects and support the team throughout the development lifecycle.
job.Who Can Apply:
Only those candidates can apply who:
1. are available for the work from home job/internship
2. can start the work from home job/internship between 15th Sep'26 and 20th Oct'26
3. are available for duration of 3 months
4. have relevant skills and interests
* Women wanting to start/restart their career can also apply.
